        with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as fh:

                line=fh.readline()
                if not line: break
                lines.append(line.rstrip('\\n'))
        out.append({'file':name,'size':os.path.getsize(p),'first_lines':lines})
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))"
